pokedexEntries.bk: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.wh: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

pokedexEntries.sw: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.

pokedexEntries.sh: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.
